ModMetaData.name: Rimrooms - Async Industries
ModMetaData.author: Operator
ModMetaData.description:
Build an organization that investigates, contains, and profits from unstable spaces beyond a machine gate.
Foundation build 0.1.0: includes an Operations information screen and an inactive, save-local campaign component. The company scenarios, machine gate, expeditions, and campaign gameplay are still being built. This is not a playable campaign release.
Designed for RimWorld 1.6. Core-only development foundation; no DLC or Harmony required by this package. RimWorld Together cooperation and optional integrations are planned and unverified.
Author: Operator.
